Despite this, the amendment passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions, including France.

round_robin.body:
Procedural officer: At S/PV.9518, the US proposed an amendment to clarify financing limits, which passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions, including France. The amended draft subsequently passed unanimously.

United States: The US proposed an amendment to clarify financing limits, seeking an explicit contribution cap to remove ambiguity and enable timely deployment. France abstained, citing insufficient clarity regarding the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.

France: France abstained on the US amendment clarifying financing limits, citing insufficient clarity on the 25 percent outside assessed contributions. While the amendment passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions including France, the Council unanimously adopted the amended draft.
